configuration.channel_model: Sionna TimeChannel with sampled waveform-domain TDL
configuration.receive_spatial_correlation_assumption: uncorrelated; no spatial_corr_mat or rx_corr_mat supplied to Sionna TDL
configuration.single_rx_policy: decode receive antenna index 0 from each generated two-antenna waveform
configuration.snr_definition: complex AWGN variance 10**(-SNR_dB/10); measured pre-noise receive power is recorded separately for each antenna and batch
configuration.two_rx_policy: decode receive antenna indices 0 and 1 from the same waveform and channel draw

limitations: Only Sionna TDL-A, one numerology, one bandwidth, one DMRS pattern, speed, and delay spread are evaluated.
The two receive antennas follow Sionna's default spatial-correlation configuration; no measured array calibration is used.
Synchronization is ideal and the 100-ns channel memory is CP-contained for this link.
Inference is conditional on the simulated codewords and does not represent independent scenes or measured channels.
